targets.title: NEVER BREAK YOUR TRADING RULES! ❤️ Even After 10 Losses!
targets.author: Infinity trading Academy FX
targets.text:
NEVER BREAK YOUR TRADING RULES! ❤️ | Trading Psychology

Trading Discipline is what separates emotional decisions from planned trading decisions.

Jab aap trading seekhte ho, toh sabse pehle apne rules aur trading plan ko samajhna zaroori hai.

Market mein losses honge, winning streaks bhi aayengi, lekin apne emotions ke according trading rules change karna dangerous ho sakta hai.

Remember these important trading lessons:

🎯 Always follow your trading plan.
🧠 Control Fear, Greed and FOMO.
🛡️ Never ignore Risk Management.
📊 Review your trading performance.
⏳ Be patient and disciplined.

targets.title: Why Most Traders Keep Repeating the Same Mistakes | Mindset and Risk Management | Ravindra Rokade
targets.author: Alice Blue
targets.text:
Why do traders repeat the same mistakes even when they know what is wrong? 🤔

In this Trade School podcast, Ms. Kajal Girase (Vice President) talks to Mr. Ravindra Rokade, Founder of Stock Niti, about trading psychology, discipline and money management. He also shares what he learned from a 30-day trading challenge with traders who had faced heavy losses.

In this episode:
✅ Certainty vs probability: why our brain fights the market
✅ Why traders overtrade to recover losses
✅ FOMO and how it breaks a trading plan
✅ Why moving your stop loss is a warning sign
✅ The cricket team analogy for judgi
